user.title: Add an IR television
user.description: Give this TV a name. You will map power, volume, playback, and sources in the next steps. Each command can be a Broadlink IR code (`remote.send_command`) or a Home Assistant button (`button.press`).

defaults.title: Default Broadlink remote
defaults.description: Optional. If most keys live on one Broadlink remote, pick it from the dropdown of available `remote.*` entities (and the device name you used when learning codes). Later steps can leave the remote empty and only ask for the command name.

data_description.default_remote: Select a `remote.*` entity from the dropdown. Official Broadlink is typical.
data_description.default_device: The device label stored in the Broadlink integration, for example `living_room_tv`. Leave empty if unused.

power_mode.title: Power
power_mode.description:
Most TVs have either separate on/off keys or a single power toggle. Current mappings:
{current}

power_sensor.title: Power state sensor
power_sensor.description:
Optional. Pick a `binary_sensor` that reports whether the TV is actually on (smart plug, current clamp, HDMI-CEC, template, …). When set, this media player uses it as power feedback instead of assumed state. Leave empty to keep assumed on/off.

Current sensor: {current_sensor}

data_description.power_sensor: on = TV is on, off = TV is off. Clear the field to disable feedback.
data_description.power_sensor_invert: Enable if this sensor is on when the television is off.

command.title: Map: {command}
command.description:
Configure **{command}** (`{command_key}`).

• Broadlink: choose a `remote.*` entity from the dropdown (or rely on the default), then pick/enter the Broadlink device name and learned command.
• Button: choose a `button.*` entity from the dropdown.

data_description.remote_entity: Required for Broadlink unless you set a default remote.
data_description.device: Required by the official Broadlink integration in most setups.
data_description.command: The name you gave the code when you learned it (for example `power_on`).
data_description.button_entity: Required when the control method is Button.

volume_select.title: Volume
volume_select.description:
Select the volume keys this TV should expose to Home Assistant and the Apple Control Center Remote (HomeKit). Leave empty to skip. Current mappings:
{current}

playback_select.title: Playback
playback_select.description:
If you only have one Play/Pause IR key, select that one — Play, Pause, and Play/Pause in Home Assistant will all use it. Current mappings:
{current}

channel_select.title: Channel / tracks
channel_select.description:
These become Next / Previous on the Apple Control Center Remote (channel up/down or track skip). Current mappings:
{current}

nav_select.title: Direction pad and menu keys
nav_select.description:
Map these so the Apple Control Center Remote D-pad works (HomeKit `homekit_tv_remote_key_pressed`). They also become extra button entities on the same TV device for dashboards. Current mappings:
{current}

source_ask.title: Input sources
source_ask.description: Sources appear in `source_list` and in the Apple Home / Control Center Remote source picker (HDMI 1, Netflix, …). If you add none, a default **TV** source is still advertised so HomeKit can create the Remote. Configured sources ({source_count}): {source_names}

source_add.title: New source
source_add.description: Display name shown in Home Assistant and on the Apple Control Center Remote source list.

source_action.title: Source action: {source_name}
source_action.description: What should happen when someone selects **{source_name}**?

error.duplicate_source: A source with this name already exists.
error.missing_remote: Pick a remote entity, or go back and set a default Broadlink remote.
error.missing_command: Enter the learned Broadlink command name.
error.invalid_entity: That entity is not a remote or button in the expected domain.
error.invalid_repeats: Repeats must be a whole number between 1 and 10.
error.no_commands: Configure at least one command or one source before finishing.
error.invalid_power_sensor: Pick a binary_sensor entity, or leave the field empty.

init.title: Configure IR Television
init.description: **{name}** — {command_count} command(s), {source_count} source(s). Power sensor: {power_sensor}. Changes are kept until you choose Save and reload.

defaults.title: Default Broadlink remote
defaults.description: Used when a later Broadlink mapping leaves the remote or device field empty.

power_mode.title: Power
power_mode.description:
Choosing a new mode replaces the current power mappings.
{current}

power_sensor.title: Power state sensor
power_sensor.description:
Optional `binary_sensor` for real on/off. When set, the TV is no longer assumed-state for power. Clear the entity to go back to assumed on/off.

Current sensor: {current_sensor}

data_description.power_sensor: on = TV is on, off = TV is off.
data_description.power_sensor_invert: Enable if this sensor is on when the television is off.

volume.title: Volume / mute
volume.description:
Keep, replace, or remove each mapping.
{current}

playback.title: Playback
playback.description:
Keep, replace, or remove each mapping.
{current}

channel.title: Channel / tracks
channel.description:
Keep, replace, or remove each mapping.
{current}

navigation.title: Direction pad and menu keys
navigation.description:
These are sent by the Apple Control Center Remote (HomeKit D-pad) and also become extra button entities on the TV device.
{current}

source_delete.title: Delete a source
source_delete.description: This only removes the mapping from this integration. Learned IR codes are not deleted.

save.title: Save
save.description: Fix the errors below, then open the menu and choose Save and reload again.
